Desid. अजिजिषति, to be desirous of driving
आज् (आ-√ अज्), -अ॑जति (Subj. आ॑जाति; Impv. 2. sg. -अज, or आ॑जा, 2. pl. Ā. -अजध्वम्) to drive towards (as cattle or enemies), RV.; VS.; AitBr.
